title: systemd-pcrlock log fails to read hyper-v vTPMs on Azure
decision_evidence: The pcrlock utility fails to read the virtual TPM log in the Hyper-V Azure environment. The linked commit changes pcrlock.c.

title: plucky/s390x does not come up after kernel update + reboot, due to udev rules missing in initrd
decision_evidence: The s390x Ubuntu initramfs is missing udev rules. The distribution integration fix changes the udev hook before userspace device initialization.

title: PTP device symlink missing after running udevadm trigger command
decision_evidence: The PTP symlink is missing after the udev trigger action. The debdiff identifies a single named udev repair payload and package bookkeeping.

title: on WSL systemd status fails output
decision_evidence: The systemd status path fails under WSL. The linked patch series changes cgroup handling in the manager and supporting code.

title: bonded link goes down on reconfigure
decision_evidence: The report gives reconfiguration as the trigger. The fix changes ordering but the report does not establish a race. The original paper uses Concurrency/Multi-thread.

title: Hang in `journalctl` when reading a corrupted journal
decision_evidence: Journal reader library hangs on corrupted journal input. The fix is in sd-journal/journal-file.c.

title: Udevd worker process does not restore inotify watches when a child script times out and subsequently the worker is killed due to timeout.
decision_evidence: The udev worker loses watches after a child script timeout. The fix changes worker timeout handling in udev-manager.c.

title: No PropertiesChanged signal emitted when freezing/thawing unit
decision_evidence: The PID 1 unit manager fails to emit a notification during a freeze or thaw transition. The diff changes unit and cgroup management.

title: Handling of incomplete sysupdate components
decision_evidence: The sysupdate utility mishandles incomplete versions during an update. The dominant change is in sysupdate state handling.

title: `journalctl --unit` bash tab completion gives the wrong units when `--user` is used
decision_evidence: The user-facing journalctl completion returns the wrong units for a normal command option. The patch is in its shell completion.

title: systemd-logind: Assertion 'resume_config_devno > 0' failed at src/shared/hibernate-util.c:396, function find_suitable_hibernation_device_full(). Aborting.
decision_evidence: The logind service aborts in the reported swap configuration. Available evidence does not resolve whether external environment or an exceptional runtime state is decisive.
